notes: Prepare phone 0.1.13: single taps select and popup actions execute once; double taps edit inline, and the keyboard checkmark saves locally. Stable menu geometry prevents keyboard dismissal from cancelling a press. A serialized SQLite writer gate prevents Undo/calendar contention and recovers after failed transactions without consuming history. Clipboard actions await local work only; background synchronization is coalesced and refreshes foreground accounts every 15 seconds. Remove copied banners and automatic minute/range panels. Header Sync refreshes calendars; the gear contains Settings, Print, Search and Dashboard. Linked source color edits preserve notes, groups and formatting. Calendar descriptions compact identical adjacent notes with version-two metadata and v1 baseline compatibility. Published phone 0.1.12 remains current until separate native verification and publication. F-Droid/watch 0.1.8 remain existing releases; physical Android gestures, official catalog acceptance and store review are not verified.
